description: This file defines the CardEmulationFragment class, a UI component for an Android application that displays a simple interface allowing the user to view and update a card account string. It manages user input through a TextWatcher to synchronize the account data stored in AccountStorage.

classes.name: CardEmulationFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass managing a basic UI for card emulation features, including an input field for account information.

methods.description: Initializes the fragment when created; calls super implementation.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout, initializes the account input field, sets its initial text, and adds a text change listener.

methods.description: No operation, placeholder for pre-text change logic.

methods.description: No operation, placeholder for handling text change events.

methods.name: AccountUpdater.afterTextChanged
methods.description: Updates the stored account information when the user modifies the input field.
